devs.metaDesc: Publish indie games on Dustore: 0% fee for jam-born games, fair discovery, expert reviews.
devs.title: Publish games where they get found
devs.lead: Dustore is built by developers for developers. Upload a build in a minute, get fair discovery instead of a budget race, and 0% commission on games born at our jams.

commission.d: For games born at Dustore jams we take nothing. For everything else — a fair 10%, no hidden fees.

upload.d: Drop a build — zip, apk, exe, HTML5 or wasm. Fill in profile, studio and details while the file uploads.

recommend.d: The recommendation system gives new and overlooked games a chance, not just those with a bigger promo budget.

expert.d: 'Bityi Piksel' — a breakdown by experienced developers: honest game-design feedback, not just stars.

reviews.d: Ratings from people who actually played. Play-to-vote: a vote counts only after real time in the game.

bugs.d: Players report bugs right on the game page. Structured and sent to you, not lost in the comments.

devs.commText: Games from our jams are published with 0% commission — forever. For everyone else the rate is fair and transparent.
devs.commJam: Game was born at a Dustore jam
devs.commZeroNote: ✓ 0% — a Dustore jam game. You keep the full amount.

signup.d: Same login as the main site. Already have one? Just sign in.

studio.d: A studio is your team's storefront. Solo or invite co-authors.

upload.d: Drop the file, add screenshots, description and tags. Web games run right in the browser.

publish.d: Check price and commission, hit 'Publish' — the game enters the catalog and the feed.

devs.finTitle: Ready to publish your first game?
devs.finText: All you need is a build and a couple of minutes. The platform handles the rest.
